changelog:
- Resilient Background & Screen-Off Audio Playback: Added explicit user pause tracking, webview timer guards, audio focus management, and service debounce so audio never cuts out when switching apps or locking phone.
- Truth Pulse News Overhaul: Completely removed outdated sports cards/categories, fixed card layouts, and implemented strict duplicate image prevention across editorial feeds.
- Official Monochrome Black Icon Set: Replaced brand logos and action icons with solid black SVGs matching the official reference (folded newspaper, fedora/glasses, sailboat emblem, equalizer headphones, triangular dots).
- Add to Home Screen: Pin any webpage directly to the Android launcher with its favicon via ShortcutManagerCompat.
- Add to Startpage Shortcuts: Instantly pin active websites to Fokk Start speed dial shortcuts.
- Startpage Geolocation Access: Seamless GPS resolution for local weather and location features.
